full pool weighted by inverse error
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a simple mean over all models may provide a robust baseline and test a different combination type than weighted.
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability, suggesting a weighted or DBA approach; testing DBA on the smaller pool4 may explore a different combination type.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a simple robust aggregation like median over a small, low‑error pool might capture the trend while reducing influence of outliers.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlying high‑error models.
Explore a per‑horizon weighted scheme on the trend‑dominated pool4 to capture any horizon‑specific strengths (ranking tau moderate).
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a DBA (differential weighted average) might better capture complementary errors across windows.
The series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability; a simple mean over a diverse pool may capture complementary errors.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; using a weighted combination over a more diverse pool (pool5) may capture complementary errors better than pool4.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.0802. Series context: trend strength 0.9996 and seasonal strength 0.2755; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.361); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 43.997.
